summary: The current controller preserves the selected school after a delayed fixture Registration.registerTeacher failure, but syncRuntime replaces the freshly typed registration identity with empty identity when the provider runtime has no registration. Both known transport_failure and outcome_unknown show this; neither is auto-retried, public:retry returns nothing_to_retry, and an explicit resubmit after re-entering identity succeeds. A separate existing-approved-account control also confirms an adjacent alias redirect: the approved email logs in before a failed re-registration, but login after it is sent to the never-created new fixture alias and returns not_found.

commands.command: git rev-parse HEAD HEAD^{tree}; sha256sum <six inspected source files>; git status --short --branch

checks: Inspected app.mjs delegated input listener: named non-secret inputs call controller.updateDraft before submit; delegated submit collects FormData, clears password fields, then dispatches public:register.

Inspected public-controller.mjs public:register: selected school and terms plus registration.identity are assigned before the provider call; service then invokes syncRuntime after completion; registration passes no retry callback.
Inspected syncRuntime: journey.registration is rebuilt from runtime.registration and identityByFixtureEmail, falling back to empty identity when runtime registration email has no identity mapping.

Inspected runtime/provider boundaries: credentials cross as a confirmation-valid boolean; fixture failWith transport_failure is retryable, outcome_unknown has outcomeKnown false, and failures occur before fixture mutation.

Delayed real fixture provider wrappers exercised transport_failure, outcome_unknown, and valid explicit resubmit controls; asserted rendered name/email/phone and selected school, session/registration state, retry behavior, and credential absence in controller state, runtime inspection, Parts, and storage.
Separate synthetic existing-approved-account control verified login succeeds before failed re-registration and returns not_found after alias overwrite; no source inference alone was treated as proof.

evidence.known_failure: transport_failure -> request failed; name/email/phone not retained/rendered; selected school retained; no registration/session; retry rejected; provider calls stay at one until explicit resubmit; explicit resubmit succeeds.
evidence.unknown_failure: outcome_unknown -> request outcome_unknown; name/email/phone not retained/rendered; selected school retained; no registration/session; retry rejected; provider calls stay at one until explicit resubmit; explicit resubmit succeeds.
evidence.alias_control: Approved login control true; failed re-registration returns transport_failure; subsequent login returns not_found, consistent with aliasToFixtureEmail being set to an uncreated synthetic fixture identity before provider completion.
evidence.credential_safety: Ephemeral credentials were generated at runtime and checked only with boolean absence assertions; no credential values were printed or persisted in evidence.

limits: Source/controller/renderer fixture proof only, not mounted-browser visual QA; the app's input binding was source-inspected, while the probe mirrors it through updateDraft calls.
Fixture-provider failure timing and alias controls only; no real backend, production data, or external service was used.
Repository remained read-only; probe and evidence were written only under hh-cycle10/H2/E1402.
